step.cmd: Fact-find with the client to review the advantages and disadvantages of a new initial claim:

ul.li: Advise the client that if the current claim is to be cancelled and benefits have been paid, an overpayment (OP) is established and a recovery of the OP is made from the renewed claim.
Advise clients that they will not be able to change their mind if they later realize that their decision is not the most advantageous one.

step.cmd: Determine if the client was contacted during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the client was contacted, go to step 9.
If the client was not contacted or did not reply to the N-10-00-00 letter, go to Extension not allowed . Extension not allowed

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Details: Document the fact-finding details and client decision according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
